input.relationship: src/lru.ts#admittedAllocation call src/weights.ts#allocationWeight (forward); src/weights.ts#allocationWeight value-reference src/weights.ts#entryWeight (forward)

evidence.reason: New function divides weights.allocationWeight(bytes, 0.1, 'image') by weights.byteUnit, so its result depends on allocationWeight's return semantics.
Refactored to return weightDetails(bytes, overhead, category).bytes, removing the explicit RangeError and header/byteUnit logic; correctness now depends on weightDetails.
Value-references entryWeight per the dependency path, so entryWeight's refactor propagates to admittedAllocation.
Caller returns admittedAllocation(bytes) directly, so any semantic change in the chain changes admittedBytes' output.
Caller interpolates admittedAllocation(bytes) into a label, so output changes are user-visible.
Comment states cache capacity includes index overhead in bytes; the refactor must preserve that documented behavior.
